name: video_camera_angle
description: Re-shoots the clip from a different camera position around the same subject: `rotate` swings around it, `vertical` moves above or below it, `closeup` pushes in. Regenerates the footage, so it is not a crop — reframing without new pixels is `video_crop`. The still-image equivalent is `images_change_camera`. Then `creations_show`.

closeup.description: How far to push in, 0 (unchanged) to 10 (tight).

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video creation to re-shoot.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: Optional extra direction, e.g. "keep the rain". The move itself is described by the three sliders.

rotate.description: Degrees to swing around the subject, 0-360. 0 keeps the original side.

startSeconds.description: Start of the window to re-shoot. Requires `endSeconds`. It also sets the output length.

vertical.description: Degrees above (positive, up to 90) or below (down to -30) the subject. 0 stays at eye level.
